snapshot.diff: 114 insertions, zero deletions, one tracked file: 111-line parametrized SOURCE test plus two caller comments and one awaited close

acceptance.criterion: Bad initial replacement drain is not forgiven
acceptance.basis: False drain raises H03_REPLACEMENT_NATIVE_DRAIN_UNCERTAIN before the added close, census or readers. The SOURCE negative uses the actual caller AST and real UDS authentication refusal, requires that exact exception and forbids a retirement-success checkpoint.

Only a successfully drained stream closes. The same RuntimeClient object, directory, generation and epoch remain; no launch, renewal, new authority or policy change is added. Host disconnect cleanup stops the authenticated connection and releases owner_writer. Final retirement reconnects only when writer is None through existing private-file/socket/peer validation; unchanged Host authentication, owner-writer and generation/epoch checks still apply.

acceptance.criterion: Original UNKNOWN and unsettled DB fence survive failure
acceptance.basis: Added close has no local catch. An escaping BaseException still latches cleanup_failed and unsettled, then re-raises into the unchanged finalizer. Cleanup uses |= rather than clearing the old latch, and DB clearance still requires exact resource absence and no h03_state flags. Existing actual-finalizer SOURCE controls pass for false drain, cancelled Stop and reader uncertainty; cancelled Stop explicitly requires the original docker_unknown latch.

acceptance.criterion: Fresh final Stop/status and endpoint/process/lock fence remain intact
acceptance.basis: Actual retire_host still reconnects the same disconnected client, drains via a correlated Stop followed by status readback, closes, verifies owned resource exit zero, endpoint absence, recorded process-start identities absent and runtime lock free, then refuses any cleanup/daemon uncertainty before success. No check was removed or weakened. The actual SOURCE UDS positive crosses the unchanged 2.7-second offline interval and completes this retirement path.

acceptance.criterion: Both SOURCE UDS regression cases own and clean their resources
acceptance.basis: Owned short mode-0700 TemporaryDirectory under TMPDIR; actual RuntimeHost async context encloses both branches and actual RuntimeClient.close runs in finally. The positive checks writer None, no cleanup flags, exact retirement checkpoint, no Host process and no client tasks. The negative returns only through client finally and Host context teardown. Manual positive Host shutdown is context-exit-idempotent in this exercised SOURCE fixture. NativePeer/AIAgent, PG and Docker were not launched.

command: settled_connection or (actual_lifecycle_source_seams and (drain-failed or stop-cancelled or reader-unknown or normal))
